```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(warning=FALSE, message = FALSE, echo=TRUE)
require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(modelsummary)
require(lubridate)
require(survey)
```

```{r}
bop_panel <- readRDS("~/R Projects/MD General/BOP/bop_panel.rds")
```

Variables of interest:
- Media_First
- Media_Second
- Trust_Media
- RussianMedia_Trust
- RomanianMedia_Trust
- EUMedia_Trust
- MoldovanMedia_Trust
- Newspapers_HowOften
- Radio_HowOften
- TV_HowOften
- Books_HowOften
- Internet_HowOften


```{r}
bop_panel$year <- year(bop_panel$date)
bop_panel$year.f <- as.factor(bop_panel$year)
bop_panel$wave <- as.factor(bop_panel$wave)
bop_panel$date <- as.Date(bop_panel$date)

# convert to numeric
bop_panel$MoldovanMedia_Trust <- as.numeric(bop_panel$MoldovanMedia_Trust)
bop_panel$RussianMedia_Trust <- as.numeric(bop_panel$RussianMedia_Trust)
bop_panel$RomanianMedia_Trust <- as.numeric(bop_panel$RomanianMedia_Trust)
bop_panel$EUMedia_Trust <- as.numeric(bop_panel$EUMedia_Trust)
```

```{r}
# Identifiers and demographics
vars_demographics <- c(
  "id", "wave", "date", "Age", "Age.f", "Gender", "Ethnicity",
  "Language_Questionnaire", "Ecology", "Education", "Socioeconomic",
  "Macro_Region", "Weights")

vars_media_freq <- c("Newspapers_HowOften", "Radio_HowOften", "TV_HowOften", 
                     "Books_HowOften", "Internet_HowOften")
```

```{r}
bop_panel.me <- bop_panel %>%
  drop_na(all_of(vars_demographics))

bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(MoldovanMedia_Trust)

bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(RussianMedia_Trust)

bop_panel.Ro_MediaTrust <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(RomanianMedia_Trust)

bop_panel.EU_MediaTrust <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(EUMedia_Trust)

bop_panel.Media_Freq <- bop_panel.me %>%
  drop_na(all_of(vars_media_freq))
```

# Longitudinal
```{r}
bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_mean = mean(MoldovanMedia_Trust, na.rm = TRUE),
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_sd = sd(MoldovanMedia_Trust, na.rm = TRUE),
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_n = sum(!is.na(MoldovanMedia_Trust)),
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_se = MoldovanMedia_Trust_sd / sqrt(MoldovanMedia_Trust_n),
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_lower = MoldovanMedia_Trust_mean - 1.96 * MoldovanMedia_Trust_se,
    MoldovanMedia_Trust_upper = MoldovanMedia_Trust_mean + 1.96 * MoldovanMedia_Trust_se
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(MoldovanMedia_Trust_mean, MoldovanMedia_Trust_lower,
             MoldovanMedia_Trust_upper),
    names_to = c("MoldovanMedia_Trust", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(MoldovanMedia_Trust)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(1,4)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       y = "Mean Score")
```

# Regression Analysis

## Moldovan media (Trust)
```{r}
# changing reference categories
bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust$Education, "medium")

bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust <- svydesign(id=~1, weights=~Weights, data=bop_panel.MD_MediaTrust)
```

```{r}
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Age, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Age.f, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Gender, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Ethnicity, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Language_Questionnaire, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Ecology, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Education, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Socioeconomic, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~Macro_Region, design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust~factor(year), design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust))
```

```{r}
model <- svyglm(MoldovanMedia_Trust ~ Age.f + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Ecology + Macro_Region + factor(year), design = bop_svy.MD_MediaTrust)

summary(model)
```

## Russian media (Trust)
```{r}
# changing reference categories
bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust$Socioeconomic <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust$Socioeconomic, "medium")
bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust$Education <- fct_relevel(bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust$Education, "medium")

bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust <- svydesign(id=~1, weights=~Weights, data=bop_panel.Rus_MediaTrust)
```

```{r}
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Age, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Age.f, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Gender, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Ethnicity, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Language_Questionnaire, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Ecology, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Education, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Socioeconomic, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~Macro_Region, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~MoldovanMedia_Trust, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
summary(svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust~EUMedia_Trust, design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust))
```

```{r}
model2 <- svyglm(RussianMedia_Trust ~ Age.f + Ethnicity + Language_Questionnaire + Education + Socioeconomic + Ecology + Macro_Region + MoldovanMedia_Trust + EUMedia_Trust + factor(year), design = bop_svy.Rus_MediaTrust)

summary(model2)
```
